The background consists of stylized house-shaped neon light frames in white and purple. (2) The camera cuts to an audience section where about fifteen young adults are seated in tiers. They are holding up circular orange signs with the number one printed on them, looking towards the stage with focused expressions. (3) A rapid montage follows, showing contestants engaged in various physical activities on stage. Some are running in place, while others are lunging or huddling together. The house-shaped neon frames in the background shift between pink, yellow, and blue colors. (4) The scene transitions to a specialized skit area with a sofa. Two women are performing; one acts out an intense choking and gagging reaction, clutching her chest and neck, while the other observes with a puzzled and slightly disgusted facial expression. (5) Another skit features a woman and a man at a table covered in black cloth. The woman gestures dramatically with her hands and points her finger while speaking, while the man appears to be acting as if he is intoxicated, resting his head heavily on his hand with a slumped posture. (6) The final phase returns to the main stage. The hosts stand before the line of contestants. The male host holds a brown envelope and a card, appearing to make a serious announcement. The atmosphere is tense until the final reveal, where the group breaks into cheers and smiles.
